bank.q: Students study in a ___.
bank.why: Murid belajar di kelas (classroom).

bank.q: We say ___ when we meet someone in the morning.
bank.why: Salam saat bertemu di pagi hari: Good morning.

bank.q: The ___ are playing outside.
bank.why: Bentuk jamak dari child adalah children.

bank.q: These are my books. ___ are on the desk.
bank.why: Butuh kata ganti subjek: they.

bank.q: The cat is hiding ___ the bed.
bank.why: Di bawah tempat tidur: under.

bank.q: Birds ___ fly, but penguins cannot.
bank.why: Kemampuan umum: can + verb dasar (tanpa s).

bank.q: When it is cold, I wear a ___.
bank.why: Saat dingin dipakai jaket (jacket).

bank.q: My mother ___ delicious food every day.
bank.why: Subjek orang ketiga tunggal: cooks.

bank.q: They ___ football in the yard yesterday.
bank.why: Yesterday menandakan lampau: played.

bank.q: How ___ students are there in your class?
bank.why: Students bisa dihitung: how many.

bank.q: I ___ him three times this week.
bank.why: This week belum selesai: present perfect (have met).

bank.q: Can you ___ the word in the dictionary?
bank.why: Look up = mencari kata di kamus.

bank.q: My exam result is ___ than I expected.
bank.why: Bentuk comparative dari bad adalah worse.

bank.q: She is worried ___ her exam results.
bank.why: Kolokasi tetap: worried about = khawatir tentang.

bank.q: She isn't answering. She ___ be in a meeting.
bank.why: Kemungkinan: may be = mungkin sedang.

bank.q: A new hospital ___ near my house right now.
bank.why: Pasif present continuous: is being + V3.

bank.q: The ___ of the new bridge took five years.
bank.why: Butuh kata benda: construction (konstruksi/pembangunan).

bank.q: She was cooking when I ___ home.
bank.why: Kejadian singkat di tengah kejadian yang berlangsung: past simple (got home = tiba di rumah).

bank.q: She ___ me a funny story about her cat.
bank.why: Tell + objek orang: told me a story. Say tidak diikuti objek orang langsung.

bank.q: Can I ___ early today? I have a doctor's appointment.
bank.why: Setelah can dipakai verb dasar: leave (pulang lebih awal).

bank.q: If the weather had been nice, we ___ to the beach.
bank.why: Third conditional: would have + V3.

bank.q: My mother reminded me ___ the door.
bank.why: Remind + objek + to-infinitive: reminded me to lock.

bank.q: ___ his injury, he finished the marathon.
bank.why: In spite of + kata benda. Although/even though harus diikuti klausa.

bank.q: He talks ___ he knew everything, but he doesn't.
bank.why: As if + past simple untuk situasi tidak nyata sekarang.

bank.q: When I moved to Jakarta, I felt like a fish out of ___.
bank.why: Idiom a fish out of water = merasa asing/tidak pada tempatnya.

bank.q: She ___ great progress in English this year.
bank.why: Kolokasi: make progress = membuat kemajuan.

bank.q: Please do not hesitate to ___ us if you have questions.
bank.why: Pola formal: do not hesitate to + verb dasar.

bank.q: With so much practice, you are ___ to improve.
bank.why: Be bound to = pasti akan.

bank.q: The song ___ by millions of people since its release.
bank.why: Pasif present perfect: has been + V3.

bank.q: We are considering ___ to a bigger office.
bank.why: Setelah consider memakai gerund: moving.

bank.q: The CEO's ___ lifestyle surprised everyone; he flies economy and wears old shoes.
bank.why: Frugal = hemat/sederhana. Lavish dan extravagant = mewah.

bank.q: I insist that the bill ___ paid in full today.
bank.why: Subjunctive pasif setelah insist that: be + V3.

bank.q: Only by working together ___ succeed.
bank.why: Only by di awal kalimat memicu inversi: can + subjek.

bank.q: In formal letters, "ask for" becomes ___.
bank.why: Request adalah bentuk formal dari ask for. Demand = menuntut, beg = memohon.

bank.q: You ___ as well take the bus; the train is on strike.
bank.why: Might as well = sebaiknya saja (tidak ada pilihan lebih baik).

bank.q: Not until the rain stopped ___ the match.
bank.why: Not until di awal kalimat memicu inversi: could + subjek.

bank.q: The report ___ attention to the lack of clean water.
bank.why: Kolokasi: draw attention to = mengarahkan perhatian pada.

bank.q: Rina loves spicy food, and ___ does her brother.
bank.why: Persetujuan positif: so + inversi (so does ...).

bank.q: The manager gave a ___ reply: just "no".
bank.why: Terse = singkat dan tegas. Lengthy dan wordy = panjang.

bank.q: He goes to ___ school by bus every day.
bank.why: Pergi ke sekolah sebagai murid (tujuan utama): tanpa artikel.

articles.title: Helping Mom in the Kitchen
body: Every afternoon, Dito helps his mother in the kitchen. He washes the vegetables and she cuts them. They work together and talk about Dito's day at school.
Today, they are making chicken soup. Mom puts in carrots, potatoes and beans. The soup smells very good.
At six, the family eats dinner together. Dito is proud because he helped. His father says the soup is the best in the world.

qs.q: When does Dito help his mother?
Who says the soup is the best in the world?

articles.title: The Quiet Power of Reading
body: In an age of endless videos and short messages, reading a book can feel old-fashioned. Yet research keeps showing that people who read regularly gain real advantages.

First, reading trains the brain to focus for long periods, a skill that constant scrolling weakens. Second, it builds vocabulary far more effectively than watching videos, because readers meet words in context and must actively imagine the scenes.

Perhaps most importantly, fiction teaches empathy. When we follow a character's thoughts and struggles, we practice seeing the world through another person's eyes. That is why many teachers argue that reading stories is not just entertainment - it is training for real life.

qs.q: What does reading train the brain to do?
According to the text, what does fiction teach?
Why does reading build vocabulary better than watching videos?
